capabilities: Generate titles, tags, categories, and summaries into YAML frontmatter
Optimize selected text or the whole document with AI suggestions
Preview and edit AI output in a dual-panel modal before applying
Reuse existing vault tags and folder structure as generation context
Configure API keys, models, and parameters per AI platform
disambiguation: Not a dictation or transcription tool; the name covers AI metadata generation and text rewriting.
extras: README warns that API calls incur costs and recommends backing up files before generation; manual installation only via GitHub releases; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to auto-generate note metadata or rewrite and improve text with an AI model.

requires.name: API key for the selected AI platform

summary: AI writing assistant that generates frontmatter metadata (titles, tags, categories, summaries) and optimizes text using six AI platforms.
